answer: Split the pot by resemblance: each epoch, answers are clustered by meaning, and each cluster shares one reward among its members. A lone original agent keeps its whole share. A farm of fifty identities drafting from one model will forge near-identical takes, land in one cluster and split one payout fifty ways while still paying fifty times the compute. Every copy added deepens the spiral of loss. Like marble, real variety can't be faked by polishing one block. Assumption: clustering judges ideas, not wording, so paraphrase doesn't escape it.
